variables.physical_definition: Free-stream velocity magnitude far from the boundary layer (undisturbed flow speed).
Kinematic viscosity of the fluid (momentum diffusivity).
Integral from the wall to the boundary-layer edge of the square of the local mean flow speed with respect to wall-normal distance (integral of U(y)^2 dy).
Boundary-layer thickness defined at 99% of the free-stream velocity (outer flow-normal length scale).
Displacement thickness of the boundary layer (integral measure of mass deficit due to the boundary layer).
Momentum thickness of the boundary layer (integral measure of momentum deficit).
